basis: Liver dysfunction and retinal degeneration each estimated >30%; common hearing loss omitted by cap. [ZSD](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1448/).

decisions.hepatic: involved: hepatic dysfunction commonly exceeds 30% across the Zellweger spectrum, although severity varies.
decisions.neurologic: primary: neurodevelopmental impairment or progressive neurologic dysfunction characterizes the spectrum.
decisions.ocular: involved: function-impairing retinal degeneration commonly exceeds 30%; retained for severity under the cap.
decisions.otologic: none: sensorineural hearing loss is common but omitted under the four-axis cap.

basis: Nephritis 4/4, cytopenias 2/2 and pericardial effusion 3/3 assessed patients; skin and joint findings omitted by cap. Small denominators limit frequency estimates.

decisions.haematologic: involved: anemia and leukopenia each reported in 2/2 assessed patients; hematologic injury is a manifestation of systemic autoimmunity.
decisions.renal: involved: nephritis 4/4 and urinary abnormalities 5/5 establish common direct renal injury in this systemic autoimmune disorder.

basis: Developmental delay 7/7 and characteristic skeletal anomalies define the syndrome; renal abnormalities/hydronephrosis occur in 30-79%. Cardiac and sensory defects are occasional.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: prominent skeletal malformations characterize this overgrowth syndrome, including camptodactyly 7/12 and kyphoscoliosis 6/11.

basis: Dursun syndrome is a congenital neutropenic immunodeficiency with defining pulmonary arterial hypertension and atrial septal defect; pulmonary vessels map to cardiovascular.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: the leukopenia represents congenital neutropenic immunodeficiency, an intrinsic immune defect.

basis: Persistent lymphatic edema is located in skin and subcutis. Lymphatic obstruction alone establishes neither blood-vessel disease nor an immune mechanism.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: lymphatic drainage obstruction does not establish disease of the heart, arteries, veins or blood capillaries covered by this axis.
decisions.dermatologic: primary: chronic edema directly affects skin and subcutaneous tissue, which are explicitly covered by this axis.

basis: Hypomagnesemia, seizures and developmental disability define the syndrome; renal magnesium wasting in 2/2 demonstrates common intrinsic tubular dysfunction.

decisions.renal: involved: renal magnesium wasting in 2/2 establishes direct tubular loss of function accompanying the defining electrolyte and neurologic phenotype.

basis: Eczema and skeletal abnormalities occurred in both initial recessive partial-deficiency cases (2/2). [Study](https://haematologica.org/article/view/8818/62225).

decisions.dermatologic: involved: persistent eczema/atopic dermatitis affected both initially described recessive partial-deficiency patients, supporting >30%; small sample.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: craniosynostosis and scoliosis affected both initially described patients, supporting common intrinsic skeletal abnormalities; small sample.

basis: Osteoarticular disease affected 113/530 (~21%) in a prospective B. melitensis series; pain alone is insufficient. [Study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8699960/).

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: direct osteoarticular disease was ~21% in a large species-specific prospective series; estimates vary, and limb/back pain alone does not establish damage.

basis: Seizures/ID 6/6, gingival overgrowth 5/6 and hallmark nail defects define the syndrome; scoliosis 4/6 and distal phalangeal hypoplasia 3/5 support skeletal involvement.

decisions.dermatologic: primary: nail aplasia/hypoplasia is a defining Zimmermann-Laband feature; anonychia occurs in 3/5 assessed patients.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: scoliosis 4/6 and distal phalangeal hypoplasia 3/5; the three primary slots prioritize neurologic, gingival and nail hallmarks.

basis: Precursor T-cell lymphoma. Mediastinal masses do not establish pulmonary invasion; common pleural effusions do not establish direct pleural infiltration in >=30%.

decisions.pulmonary: none: neither mediastinal location nor effusion alone establishes direct lung or pleural damage; qualifying involvement in >=30% is not established.
